verdicts.claim: 06.01.04 states two mutually exclusive 'regardless' rules for one occurrence: crossing 50% presence makes it delivered regardless of what happens next; an audio-quality drop lets it end with no credit consumed regardless of the 50% rule.
verdicts.reason: Verified verbatim. 06.01.04-lesson-delivery-session-record.md:192-193 'Concurrent presence crosses **50%** of the scheduled duration → the occurrence is `delivered` regardless of what happens next'; :88 delivered ⇒ '06.01.02 consumes the reserved credit'; :227 restates it ('If concurrent presence already ≥50% → `delivered`, credit consumes'); against :229 '... or end with **no credit consumed** regardless of the 50% rule'. Two adjacent edge rows give opposite money outcomes for a post-50% transport/audio failure. The file also breaches its own seam at :24 ('It never decides a ledger effect — 06.01.03 does that') and D-06 (:363) by asserting a ledger effect. Partial mitigation exists but does not dissolve it: 06.01.03 D-16 (:258) maps 'platform-caused → no-fault; ... ≥ 50% delivered → full consumption' — which is itself ambiguous for a platform-caused failure after 50%, i.e. exactly the overlapping case. verdicts.claim: The credit lifecycle lets a lapsed credit transition straight to consumed, bypassing the reserved state the sub-domain's fail-closed reservation invariant depends on.
verdicts.reason: REFUTED. The arc is as quoted (06.01.02-lesson-packages-credits-rate-cards.md:79 'lapsed ──redeem at current list──> consumed  (student tops up the delta)'), but redemption is a booking-time act and booking universally reserves, so the diagram is a compression rather than an alternate path. 06.01-lesson-booking-packages-delivery-cx.md:36 makes it unconditional: 'Booking confirmation → reserve. If the reserve fails (insufficient balance), the **booking must fail** — fail closed, no negative balances', with :35 naming 06.01.02 the single writer and :39 routing serialization to `/create-prd-architecture`. D-04 (:288) frames redemption as booking against the current list price 'with the student topping up any delta', and edge case 5 (:193) states the same flow. No implementer builds a consume-without-reserve path for one credit class in a ledger whose stated invariant (:20) is that a credit is 'spent once and only once'.
